question: Which of the following does not come from sugarcane?
solution:
The correct answer is __**honey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Honey:-**

 
 
• **It is a sweet, golden liquid produced by bees from the nectar of flowers.**
 
• It is a natural sweetener that has been used by humans for centuries.
 
• Honey is also a good source of antioxidants and other nutrients.
 
• **Honey does not come from sugarcane.**
 
• **Honey is produced by bees from the nectar of flowers. **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sugar:-**

 
 
• **It is a refined product made from sugarcane juice. **
 
• The juice is boiled and crystallized, and the molasses is removed.
 
• Sugar is the most processed of the three products, and it is also the sweetest.
 
 
 
• **Khandsari:-**
 
 
• **It is a type of unrefined sugar that is made by boiling sugarcane juice until it thickens and forms crystals. **
 
• The molasses is not removed, so khandsari has a darker color and a more robust flavor than sugar.
 
 
 
• **Molasses:-**
 
 
• **It is a thick, dark syrup that is produced as a byproduct of sugar refining. **
 
• It contains the minerals and vitamins that are removed from sugar during processing.
 
• Molasses has a rich, sweet flavor and is often used in baking and cooking.
